title: Doubao AI Upgraded Again: One-Stop Solution for the Entire Travel Process, Targeting Life Service Entry Point

content_html:
September 30th news, Douyin's AI assistant, Doudou, has recently upgraded its functions and officially integrated travel services such as flight and train ticket booking, car hailing, and map navigation, trying to transform from a "chat assistant" to a "lifestyle service entrance".

According to the information, users can now complete the entire process of querying, comparing prices, placing orders, and refunding or changing tickets for flights and trains directly through Doudou, without having to switch to third-party platforms. The car-hailing function supports vehicle type selection and one-click calling. At the same time, Doudou has integrated navigation capabilities, providing route planning for various modes of transportation, including public transport and self-driving. In addition, the platform has launched a dedicated entry for travel guides, integrating recommended services for "eating, accommodation, travel, and sightseeing".

This upgrade signifies that Doudou is moving from a simple AI chat tool to a platform-level application that covers users' travel decision-making and execution cycle. In the increasingly competitive AI assistant market, whoever can first realize the experience of "speaking to get things done" may capture the next wave of user mindshare.
